name: Messaging & positioning workshop
whatItIs: A three-week sprint to get clear on how you should be talking about your product.
howItWorks: We review how you show up today, then I lay out realistic positioning options with tradeoffs. Once you pick a direction, I deliver an internal alignment deck and a new homepage that puts the story in language customers understand.
bestFor: When you have product-market fit but your story hasn't kept up with the product.
